paragraphes: This memorandum was prepared from information provided by the company’s owner, public data and market sources cited in the footer. This information has not been audited: its accuracy and completeness are not guaranteed.
This document is neither an offer nor a commitment. It does not replace the checks that any buyer carries out with their own advisors (accounting, legal, employment and tax due diligence).

It is provided under a confidentiality undertaking, for the sole purpose of allowing its recipient to decide whether to study the transaction. Any full or partial reproduction or distribution is prohibited.
avertissement.fort: All questions about this document or the transaction go through the owner, via Passation. The company’s employees, customers and suppliers must not be contacted directly under any circumstances.

synthese.six_points: Six strengths, developed in the memorandum’s chapters

etapes: Each interested buyer signs a confidentiality undertaking before receiving the memorandum.
Reading the memorandum, written questions, then a meeting with the owner.
Letters of intent: proposed price, financing, conditions and timeline.
The selected buyer checks the accounts, contracts, and legal, employment and tax matters.
Negotiation of the sale agreement, signing, then transfer of ownership.
Sale agreement and deed of transfer
operation.processus_message: A five-step process, conducted under a confidentiality undertaking
